## Highlights

This beta replaces the mobile WebView shell with a native Flutter client, improves endpoint and Cloud route selection, and ships the correct AnyTTY application icon on Android and iOS.

### Native Flutter mobile client

- Android now renders the mobile experience with Flutter instead of Capacitor/WebView.
- The app talks directly to the AnyTTY Go client engine and uses the pinned `libghostty-vt` adapter for terminal input.
- Native mobile workflows cover pairing, endpoint and route management, terminal creation and switching, live output and history, file browsing and transfer, settings, themes, quick keys, and touch petal menus.
- The Android package remains `com.anytty.app` and public APKs continue to use the persistent release key.

### Better endpoint and Cloud connectivity

- Endpoint and terminal pickers are searchable and expose clearer connection state.
- Route scoring preserves device labels and avoids treating an authenticated Cloud presence as a ready transport.
- Cloud route selection uses measured candidates instead of fixed assumptions.
- Cloud client certificates are renewed automatically before expiry.

### TUI setup and application branding

- First-time CLI installation writes the recommended `coralline-candy` TUI profile; existing configuration is never overwritten.
- Android packages include legacy, round, and adaptive AnyTTY launcher icons.
- iOS AppIcon assets now use the AnyTTY icon at every required size.

### Downloads

| Asset | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit ARM devices |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-arm64-v8a.apk` | Most current Android phones and tablets |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-x86_64.apk` | x86_64 devices and emulators |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-universal.apk` | One APK containing every supported ABI |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-play.aab` | Google Play upload; not directly installable |

CLI archives for macOS, Linux, and Windows are also attached. `SHA256SUMS`, build metadata, and GitHub build provenance cover every published artifact. iOS source is included in the repository; TestFlight remains the iOS distribution channel.

### Upgrade notes

The Flutter client uses a new local endpoint registry and secure credential store. Android users upgrading from the Capacitor beta must pair their endpoints again. Do not uninstall first when the installed app came from the official GitHub Release: beta.6 retains the package identity and signing key, so it can be installed over beta.5 without clearing the old application data.

Locally built APKs use a debug key and cannot replace an official release build without uninstalling it. Uninstalling clears local application data.

AnyTTY remains in beta. Protocols and local data formats may still change before the first stable release.

## 简体中文

本版本使用原生 Flutter 客户端替换手机端 WebView 外壳，改进 endpoint 与 Cloud route 选择，并为 Android 和 iOS 补齐正确的 AnyTTY App 图标。

### 原生 Flutter 手机客户端

- Android 手机端改用 Flutter 渲染，不再使用 Capacitor/WebView。
- App 直接连接 AnyTTY Go Client Engine，并通过固定版本的 `libghostty-vt` 适配层处理终端输入。
- 原生手机流程覆盖配对、endpoint 与 route 管理、终端创建与切换、实时输出与历史、文件浏览与传输、设置、主题、快捷键和触控花瓣菜单。
- Android 包名保持为 `com.anytty.app`，公开 APK 继续使用长期 release key 签名。

### 更可靠的 endpoint 与 Cloud 连接

- endpoint 和 terminal 选择器支持搜索，并提供更清楚的连接状态。
- route 评分会保留设备标签，不再把已登录的 Cloud presence 误认为可用传输路径。
- Cloud 路径选择改为基于实测候选项，不再依赖固定假设。
- Cloud 客户端证书会在到期前自动续期。

### TUI 初始化与 App 品牌图标

- CLI 首次安装会写入推荐的 `coralline-candy` TUI 配置；已有配置不会被覆盖。
- Android 安装包包含普通、圆形和自适应 AnyTTY 启动图标。
- iOS 的全部 AppIcon 尺寸均已替换为 AnyTTY 图标。

### 下载

| 资产 | 适用设备 |
| --- | --- |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-armeabi-v7a.apk` | 较老的 32 位 ARM 设备 |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-arm64-v8a.apk` | 大多数当前 Android 手机和平板 |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-x86_64.apk` | x86_64 设备和模拟器 |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-universal.apk` | 一个包含全部受支持 ABI 的 APK |
| `anytty-v0.0.1-beta.6-android-play.aab` | 上传 Google Play，不能直接安装 |

Release 同时附带 macOS、Linux 与 Windows CLI 压缩包。`SHA256SUMS`、构建信息和 GitHub build provenance 覆盖全部发布资产。仓库已包含 iOS 源码；iOS 仍通过 TestFlight 分发。

### 升级说明

Flutter 客户端使用新的本地 endpoint registry 与安全凭据存储。从 Capacitor beta 升级的 Android 用户需要重新配对 endpoint。若当前 App 来自官方 GitHub Release，请不要先卸载：beta.6 保留包名和签名 key，可以直接覆盖 beta.5，避免主动清除旧应用数据。

本地构建的 APK 使用 debug key，不能直接覆盖正式 Release；卸载 App 会清除本地应用数据。

AnyTTY 仍处于 beta 阶段，首个稳定版之前协议和本地数据格式仍可能调整。
